request.description: Gives an accepted lead back. `reason`: `unreachable`, `not_interested`, `not_eligible`, `wrong_details`, `capacity_full` or `other` (then `note` is required). The lead goes back to `new` and is routed to another CA. Partner context. The firm owner sees every lead offered to the firm; a firm member (agent) sees only leads the owner handed to them. Lead protection: before acceptance the name is shortened (e.g. `Ramesh K.`) and the business name and notes are hidden; contact details stay masked until revealed, and every reveal is logged.
